title: Skin, Oil, and Glide
summary: Oil or cream should reduce unnecessary friction without hiding skin damage.
goal: Maintain comfortable glide and safe hand control.
startingPosition: Inspect the skin and ask about product sensitivity.
instructions: Do not apply product to damaged or inflamed skin.
Use a small amount of a neutral product.
Stop if burning, itching, or rash appears.
direction: Spread product in a thin even layer.
tips: Uncertainty is enough reason to reduce intensity or postpone massage.
Safety takes priority over completing a plan.
mistakes: Trying to continue at any cost.
Making overly confident conclusions without professional assessment.
warning: This guide is educational and does not replace medical diagnosis or individualized professional advice.
